title: Simplify Docker user override contract

title: Polish builder shell identity for host-mapped UID/GID
description: The Docker phase 1 builder shell works, but interactive bash shows an unmapped UID/GID prompt (for example: I have no name!). Investigate a portable way to improve shell UX without hardcoding local users or adding heavy runtime indirection.
